item.title: Single-Spin Quantum Microscope Helps Researchers Tackle Processor-Memory Bottleneck
item.summary: Insider Brief PRESS RELEASE — Artificial intelligence faces an energy crisis, stemming from a physical traffic jam inside modern computer chips. Processors must continually shuffle data, such as the billions of parameters in complex models, between separate computing and memory nodes.
